svg.title: SwinUNETR adapter and hierarchical segmentation path
svg.desc: A source-verified, grayscale-safe architecture map for the repository's lazy MONAI SwinUNETR adapter. A four-channel three-dimensional MRI tensor enters the adapter, crosses a public swinViT encoder boundary, follows four hierarchical Swin stages into a decoder with conceptual skip fusion, and exits as raw three-region logits in ET, TC, WT order. Lower notes show the optional transform adapter, training contract, shape and window settings, and source anchors. Internal MONAI block names are intentionally not asserted.

g.text: A canonical 3-D path: keep MONAI internals inside one adapter, expose one encoder boundary, and return raw region logits.
raw logits · ET / TC / WT · no activation or reorder
solid arrows = forward path · dashed = skip/API boundary
internal MONAI path · names not public API
Internal stage names are intentionally omitted: adapter depends on network.swinViT, nn.Module forward, and the verified output shape—not private MONAI paths.
configuration and orchestration anchors kept outside conceptual MONAI internals
mapping: image + label, or case record
loss: dice_ce · sigmoid Dice in loss
HAND-AUTHORED · GRAYSCALE-SAFE · EMBEDDED STYLES · NO EXTERNAL RESOURCES
